name: Butcher's Delight!
source:
A psychological horror Visual Novel about the bizarre mind of a serial killer.

Submerge yourself in her world and help her complete her mission to make the loveliest of meals along the way… or perhaps, there’s another way to go around things.

Butchers and Cattle. 

Which one are you?

[From [url=https://platedr.itch.io/butchers-delight]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部深入连环杀手怪诞内心世界的心理恐怖视觉小说。

沉浸入她的世界，协助她一路完成烹制至美佳肴的使命……又或者，事情还有另一条截然不同的解决之道。

屠夫与待宰牲畜。

你，究竟是哪一方？

[摘自[url=https://platedr.itch.io/butchers-delight]itch.io[/url]]
